name: Master Caution, Drawn
tagline: Master Caution with only its pictures redrawn: the question asked over the family's weekend country with the flight plan leaving home, every arrow, caret and fold on one solid drafting head, and each kind of idea a small badge in its own colour.
concept: A graphics mutant of Master Caution: the colours, type and layout are the parent's, and only its pictures change, three ways. (1) The greeting's picture: Home's question 'What are we planning?' is asked over the family's weekend country at night, drawn in the console's steel on the foot of the writing area, its ground the box's own rule: a far range, a flat-topped mountain, a snow-capped peak, a stand of firs, and home with its window lit (the one point of phosphor in it, her screen, where the family's words go). From home the flight plan's violet legs leave for two ringed stops, drawn as Coming up draws them below, so the picture says what the box is for: plans leaving home. It fades out where the words start, sits under the question and the placeholder, and is faint enough to write over. (2) The direction marks, one family: every arrow is a 2-unit shaft on one solid drafting head, 60 degrees at its point, drawn at 1.15em of the words it leads on from; alone, the same head at the same size is a fold's marker (it turns down as the fold opens), a select's caret and the menu's caret. Things are outlined pictograms; directions are solid marks. The setup pages' typed arrows are the same icon now. (3) The kinds as badges: each kind of idea is a small square plate tinted in its own colour, a finer edge in that colour and its glyph redrawn to read at 22px, the same drawing at any size (22px beside its name on Home, Ideas and Restaurants; 34px on an idea's own page and on the way to the restaurants). Painted, never lit; the warm kinds are tinted lighter so none becomes a brown chip.
companions: Slate (#111716) for every bay under one 2px top rule; the latched dark key (surface-3, a 2px steel cap #a9c4d8 and the jewel lamp) for 'here' and 'this one' everywhere: the bar, the filters, the settings nav, and today's numeral on the month; steel (#6f8596) for the log's wire and the family's stops and a faint wash down today's column; pewter for off, for flown days and the folded strip; violet (#a191bd, flown #6d6280) only for the flight plan's lines, rings and leg lengths; amber (#e3a651, its own --caution token) only for the master caution's lamp, edge and figure, and for late (words, bar lamp, a row's edge); clay (#bf8a6a) for the restaurant swatch and its icon, with the seasonal swatch moved to mulberry (#c86f96) to stay apart from it.
